text: Could you make me a matching event pack with a poster, a vertical story image and a vertical reel that all look like they belong together? I’m excited about this event, and having the visuals together will make it feel a bit more real to me. The poster should be 4:5 and the reel should be 10 seconds long, and all three need to say Lantern Night Market / 18 September 2027 / 6–10 PM / Riverside Yard / Free entry. For the look, please use warm lanterns with midnight blue and gold. I always worry that I’ll get caught up in how pretty something looks and forget whether people can actually read it. Please keep the reel text easy to read.
